title: Active Buyer Rates on Emergency Dispatch Charges — Calloway Limited Home Warranty
content:
Under the Calloway Limited Home Warranty, the emergency dispatch charge carries an active-buyer multiplier, applied to the program's emergency dispatch fee in the scheduled dispatch charge.

**Rule.** The active-buyer multiplier reads the homeowner's other Calloway contracts: a homeowner with a Home Purchase Agreement under construction or with a closing scheduled takes 0.50; a homeowner with no such agreement but with a Homesite Reservation on hold and with a reservation deposit received on the homeowner's homesite ledger within the last 12 calendar months (dated later than the same calendar day 12 months before the assessment day) takes 0.75; any other homeowner takes 1.00, that is, no adjustment.

## Records read

- *Home Purchase Agreement*: whether any agreement the homeowner holds has the status under construction or closing scheduled.
- *Homesite Reservation*: whether any reservation the homeowner holds is on hold (held), and whether the homeowner's homesite ledger shows a reservation deposit received in the window.

## Truth table

| Agreement under construction or closing scheduled | Reservation on hold | Reservation deposit received in the last 12 calendar months | Active-buyer multiplier |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | any | any | 0.50 |
| No | Yes | Yes | 0.75 |
| No | Yes | No | 1.00 |
| No | No | any | 1.00 |

**Window boundary (hypothetical).** Assessed on 1 July 2025, a reservation deposit received on 2 July 2024 is inside the window; one received on 1 July 2024 is not.
